title: My Family
moral: Family love grows with kindness and care.

scenes.summary: A child introduces their family members.
scenes.text: This is my family. Mommy, Daddy, and me!
scenes.image_prompt: happy cartoon family with mommy daddy and child smiling together colorful children's book style

scenes.summary: The child learns that a new baby is coming.
scenes.text: Mommy is going to have a baby.
scenes.image_prompt: pregnant mommy with child looking curious and happy bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: The baby arrives and the child meets their new sister Tiny.
scenes.text: She brings home a new baby sister. "This is Tiny," says Daddy.
scenes.image_prompt: family welcoming a newborn baby sister at home joyful colorful cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: The child wonders about the baby and learns that the baby likes them.
scenes.text: "Does she like big trucks?" I ask. "Tiny likes you," says Mommy.
scenes.image_prompt: child asking parents about baby while imagining toy trucks bright playful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: The child plays with the baby and expresses love for Tiny.
scenes.text: I act silly for Tiny. Tiny smiles. I love Tiny.
scenes.image_prompt: child making funny faces to make baby laugh heartwarming colorful cartoon illustration

story: This is my family. Mommy, Daddy, and me! Mommy is going to have a baby. She brings home a new baby sister. "This is Tiny," says Daddy. "Does she like big trucks?" I ask. "Tiny likes you," says Mommy. I act silly for Tiny. Tiny smiles. I love Tiny.
